snippet.title: Zoochosis - Announcement Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ZOOCHOSIS ON SONY PLAYSTATION 4 and 5 NOW!
 
Zoochosis is a bodycam horror simulation game. You’re a zookeeper. Identify infected mutant animals, make a vaccine and cure them. Will you save all of them and survive?

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games #zoochosis 

Rated Mature
